item.title: No. 23 Gators score winning run on balk to take series from No. 22 Hurricanes
item.description: The Gators took a late lead over the Hurricanes on a seventh-inning balk before securing an 8-4, series-clinching win over Miami.

item.title: Lightning drubbed by Sabres 6-2 for second consecutive loss
item.description: Andrei Vasilevksiy, who was 17-0-1 in his previous starts, was pulled after allowing five goals on 14 shots in his first regulation loss since Dec. 18.

item.title: Rally falls short as UCF sees three-game win streak snapped by Baylor
item.description: The Knights rallied from a double-digit deficit in the final six minutes to tie the game before a late foul cost them the game.

item.title: No. 7 Gators enter March red hot after rout of No. 20 Arkansas
item.description: No. 7 Florida picked up its ninth straight win with a 111-77 rout of No. 20 Arkansas to secure the Gators' eighth SEC regular-season title.

item.title: Orlando high school scores and statistics from Saturday, Feb. 28
item.description: Boys hoops regional titlists were Oak Ridge, CFCA, Lake Mary, Lake Howell and Evans, while Hagerty and Freedom won wrestling region titles. Ocoee and St. Cloud won boys track meets, while Lake Minneola and Jones won girls track meets.

item.title: Oak Ridge scores 98; Lake Mary-Winter Park bizarre finish | FHSAA Basketball
item.description: FHSAA basketball region finals were drenched in drama: Orlando No. 1 Lake Highland stopped; Oak Ridge scored 98; Lake Howell, Evans rallied; CFCA sunk OCP; and Lake Mary-Winter Park had bizarre finish.
